app_info.subtitle: AI teammates with audit trails
app_info.description: Create, manage, and automate apps in Inistate directly from Claude using simple natural language. Your AI teammate can manage workflows, update records, trigger approvals, upload files, and handle daily operations entirely through Claude or any AI client. Full traceability, confidence-gated escalation, and human oversight are built in. No system prompt required—the schema is the prompt.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the workspaces available to the authenticated user without changing any records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private workspace data in Inistate and does not publish or modify public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or perform any irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Changes the active workspace context for subsequent backend operations in the current session.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only changes private session context for Inistate workspace operations and does not affect public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete data or perform an irreversible mutation.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists modules in the current workspace without modifying their definitions.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private module data in Inistate and does not publish or modify public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not remove, overwrite, or irreversibly change data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves a module schema so the user can inspect fields, states, activities, and flows.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private module configuration in Inistate and does not affect public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or make irreversible changes.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only fetches the current module definition and stable IDs for inspection or later editing.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private module configuration in Inistate and does not publish or modify public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not remove data or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only queries and returns matching module entries without changing any records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private workspace records in Inistate and does not publish or modify public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves a single entry and its current state without modifying it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private workspace entry data in Inistate and does not affect public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or irreversibly alter data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only returns form fields, options, and requirements for an activity without submitting anything.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private workflow form metadata in Inistate and does not publish or modify public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or trigger irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates, updates, comments on, deletes, or changes the state of workflow entries and therefore modifies backend data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only updates private workflow records inside Inistate and does not publish or modify public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can perform high-impact persistent actions such as deleting entries or changing workflow state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the audit trail and comments for an entry without modifying the record.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private audit data in Inistate and does not affect public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Uploads a file into workspace storage and therefore creates new stored data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only uploads files for private Inistate workspace use and does not publish them to public internet destinations.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a file artifact but does not itself delete or irreversibly overwrite existing records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves a temporary download link or file data for an existing workspace file.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only retrieves private Inistate file access data and does not publish or modify public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or trigger irreversible changes.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a presigned upload session for workspace storage and therefore initiates a write-oriented operation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only prepares a private Inistate file upload and does not publish content to public internet destinations.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete data or perform an irreversible mutation by itself.

justifications.read_only_justification: Registers a completed upload with the backend and therefore changes stored workspace metadata.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only finalizes private Inistate file state and does not publish or modify public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or irreversibly overwrite existing records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only generates a workflow schema draft in the response and does not persist anything.
justifications.open_world_justification: Computes a schema draft locally from the provided prompt without calling external services.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or make irreversible changes.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only validates a proposed schema and returns checks without saving any changes.
justifications.open_world_justification: Analyzes the provided schema locally without calling external services.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads the shape of existing data (a Notion database, Airtable base/table, or local SQLite table) and returns a drafted module schema; it does not create or modify any Inistate module or the source data.
justifications.open_world_justification: May read data from external services such as Notion or Airtable, using credentials supplied via the environment, in order to infer a schema.
justifications.destructive_justification: Only reads source data and produces a draft; it does not delete, overwrite, or irreversibly change the source or any Inistate records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a new module in the workspace and therefore persists new configuration data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only creates private workspace configuration in Inistate and does not publish or modify public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a new module but does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform an irreversible destructive action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Updates an existing module definition and therefore modifies persistent workspace configuration.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only updates private workspace configuration in Inistate and does not publish or modify public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can overwrite important module structure such as fields, states, activities, or flows.

justifications.read_only_justification: Bulk variant of submit_activity — creates, updates, deletes, or changes state of multiple workflow entries in a single call, modifying backend data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only updates private workflow records inside Inistate and does not publish or modify public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can perform high-impact persistent actions across multiple entries at once, including deletion and workflow state changes.

justifications.read_only_justification: Enables or disables tool groups and resources on the server, changing the active tool surface for the session.
justifications.open_world_justification: Modifies only local server-side state; does not call any external APIs.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete data or perform any irreversible action—mode can be switched back at any time.

test_cases.expected_output: A list of workspaces you are in.
A list of modules in MCP Demo workspace.

test_cases.description: List unfinished tasks from To Do List module.
test_cases.expected_output: A list of tasks that are not marked as done in the to do list.

test_cases.description: Adds a new entry to todo list.
test_cases.user_prompt: Add TODO: Mop the floor at 2pm today
test_cases.expected_output: A new task entry "Mop the floor" should be added to todo list at the given date time with To Do state.
The entry "Mop the floor" should be marked as done state.

negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because creating workspaces is outside the supported tool surface.
The app should not be invoked because weather requests are outside Inistate workspace operations.
The app should not be invoked because generic S3 upload requests are outside the intended Inistate workflow context.
